Expected points = 0.1*(expKR*ypKR + expPR*ypPR) + 6*tdPct/100 exactly (tdPct = expected return TDs per game x100 = KR share-weighted TD hazard; pTD in table = simulated P(>=1 return TD)). Method: (1) team volume: Poisson GLM on 2018-2026 team-games, kickoffs received ~ opponent implied points (b=0.027/pt) and punts received ~ both implied points, using Week 7 spread/total lines; underdispersed counts simulated with binomial (kicks phi=0.52) and phi=0.79 for punts. (2) KR returned rate: 2026-to-date league rate (0.804, prior-season blend m=40) + empirical-Bayes kicker effect (method-of-moments tau^2, current season only, kicker effect does not carry across seasons) + game-context logit (|spread| coef -0.040, total 0.020). PR returned rate: pooled 0.430 + favourite effect. (3) Returner share: conditional-logit on candidates (depth chart rank, Blueberry KR1/KR2/PR, recency-weighted usage, prior-season usage, availability) fit on 2026 weeks 1-6 with ridge; Questionable players weighted by P(play) from practice status (Full .85, Limited .60, DNP .45); game-level share noise = Dirichlet (K=1.1, P=0.3, MLE).
